trailhead.label: Chapella, La Resgia bus stop, the board’s start

cautions: About 3.3 km of quiet tarred road between Chapella and Susauna, open to cars: lead on and keep to the side.
Cattle may graze in Val Susauna in summer: keep your dog on a short lead and go round the herd.
The gravel road is open to farm and forestry vehicles.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Cattle may graze in Val Susauna in summe: D'estate in Val Susauna possono pascolare i bovini: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto e aggira la mandria.
textIt.The gravel road is open to farm and fore: La strada sterrata è aperta ai mezzi agricoli e forestali.
